[opaque block] Moving you to bcc, and adding Vera Zakem, our new Senior Advisor for Tech and Democracy and overall
lead on disinformation. Clare and Danny, it's great to e-meet you, and I'd love to chat. It's nothing urgent, but if we can
find a time this week, let's do it; after that I'll be out for two weeks, then back in town for a while. My colleague Sofie
(also cc'd) can help us find a time. Thank you!
Johnny

[opaque block] and good to meet you Johnny
Many thanks for making the connection.
We'd be delighted to set up a call and share more of our work and our perspective on the business model of
disinformation. We'd be very interested to hear more about how USAID is thinking about the challenge also.
